data.long_meaning: Netra is derived from the Sanskrit word meaning 'eye' or 'vision'. In Hindu mythology, Netra is the name of several deities associated with the divine power of sight and perception. It is also believed that the name bestows upon the child the ability to see the world with clarity and understanding. The name Netra carries the meaning “Eye, Vision” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Netra usually hope their child will grow to embody eye, vision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
